categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai OPM Biosciences Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: cell culture media products and biopharmaceutical contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) services. The company provides a comprehensive range of cell culture media tailored for various cell types including CHO, HEK293, insect cells, and vaccine-related cells. Its CDMO services cover the full lifecycle of biopharmaceutical development from antibody engineering, cell line construction, process development, to clinical and commercial production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in chemically defined, serum-free cell culture media with complex formulations containing 70-100 chemical components optimized for high-density cell culture and protein expression. It employs advanced cell line development technologies, including stable and transient transfection platforms for CHO and HEK293 cells. The production process involves precise control of component mixing and dissolution, large-scale GMP-compliant manufacturing facilities, and integrated CDMO platforms with upstream and downstream process development, formulation, and quality analysis capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: OPM Biosciences serves over 800 domestic and international biopharmaceutical companies and research institutions, focusing on clients engaged in biopharmaceutical development including monoclonal antibodies, vaccines, cell and gene therapies, and recombinant proteins. Its products and services support drug discovery, preclinical and clinical development, and commercial manufacturing stages. The company’s customer base includes innovative drug developers and vaccine manufacturers requiring high-quality cell culture media and CDMO services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Shanghai and subsidiaries in other Chinese regions such as Taicang and Suzhou. It has a growing international presence, notably through its wholly-owned subsidiary in the United States (OPM Biosciences Inc.) which supports overseas market development, product registration, and technical support. Overseas revenue increased significantly, reflecting successful global expansion efforts.
categories.supply_chain_position: OPM Biosciences operates upstream and midstream in the biopharmaceutical supply chain. It produces critical raw materials (cell culture media) essential for biopharmaceutical production and provides integrated CDMO services that encompass cell line development, process optimization, and commercial drug substance and drug product manufacturing, thereby bridging early-stage research and commercial production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on continuous innovation in chemically defined, serum-free cell culture media and expanding its CDMO service capabilities to cover clinical phase III and commercial production. It invests heavily in R&D to develop new media formulations for emerging fields such as vaccines, insect cells, cell therapy, and gene therapy. The company also emphasizes global regulatory compliance, intellectual property protection, and digital transformation to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of cell culture media products and related consumables, as well as through CDMO service contracts. The CDMO revenue is recognized based on milestone achievements or upon delivery and client acceptance of services. The company also engages in OEM manufacturing and licensing of proprietary products. Direct sales constitute the majority of revenue, supplemented by distributor channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: OPM Biosciences competes with major international suppliers of cell culture media such as Thermo Fisher, Danaher, and Merck, as well as domestic biotech firms. It positions itself as a leading domestic innovator with a comprehensive product portfolio and integrated CDMO services, aiming to reduce reliance on imports and capture growing market share in China and internationally. Its competitive advantages include proprietary formulations, GMP-compliant manufacturing, and a full-service CDMO platform.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 297 million, a 22.26% increase over the previous year, driven by strong growth in product sales and overseas markets. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 21 million, down 61.04% due to increased fixed costs from new production facilities, asset impairment, and higher tax rates. The company maintains substantial total assets of over RMB 2.28 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, reflecting a growth-oriented profile despite short-term profitability pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: OPM Biosciences offers high-quality, chemically defined, serum-free cell culture media that enable high-density cell growth and enhanced protein expression, supporting cost-effective biopharmaceutical production. Its integrated CDMO platform provides end-to-end solutions from cell line development to commercial manufacturing, ensuring regulatory compliance and quality assurance. The company emphasizes innovation, customization, and rapid response to customer needs, positioning itself as a reliable partner that reduces dependency on imported products and accelerates drug development timelines.
